components.buttons_lead: borealis' five styles, Cadran's pills, an icon before the text or alone.
components.cadran_styles: Cadran's pills, an icon, a menu
components.values_lead: borealis' cells in a Cadran card: a switch, a choice, a list, the keyboard, a slider.
components.open_settings_note: The same cells on a screen of their own, which Cadran dresses in cards by itself.
components.progress_lead: Bars that ease to their value, and a slider; the Wait dialog has a spinner.
components.chips_lead: A pill says a state by its colour and its shape.
components.dialogs_lead: Confirmations, lists of values, a checklist, hold to confirm, a spinner, a QR code, the keyboard.
components.toasts_lead: A toast says what happened; a failure is a dialog.
components.images_lead: The same picture, fitted, filled, stretched and centred.
components.icons_lead: About sixty vector icons, drawn in any colour; a theme may replace each one.
components.empty_text: What an empty list shows: why, and what comes next.

about.title: Aurore
about.description: A C++ library for interfaces made for a controller, a TV and touch, after borealis: the Switch, PS4, PS Vita, Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux and the browser.
about.credits_lead: Aurore is borealis under a new name, and stands on the work of its authors.
about.natinusala: Wrote borealis, the library Aurore comes from.
about.xfangfang: Its fork, branch wiliwili, that Aurore follows.
about.contributors_text: Everyone who fixed, ported and improved it over the years.
about.jigsawfr: Maintains Aurore and Cadran, its look.
about.licences_lead: An app built with Aurore and Cadran is under the GPLv3.
about.licence_core: borealis' code, Aurore's core and this demo's
about.notices: Every component, its version and its licence: resources/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, in every app's resources.

cadran.confirm_text:
Save these settings?

They apply to every screen.
cadran.delete_text:
Delete this profile?

Its history goes with it.
cadran.check_bad: The SD card is almost full
cadran.refused_text: Not now: the console is busy
cadran.notice_text: Your library is ready to play.
cadran.error_what: The save could not be copied

styles.announced_hint: Move the focus: what a screen reader would say shows here.

home.pitch: A Switch-like interface for your app, on every screen.
home.more: C++ and XML, a controller first, touch and mouse too. This whole demo is built with it.
home.dashboard_lead: Drawn live with nanovg: the ring and the bars grow as the tab opens.
home.link_library: A grid of hundreds of games

library.hide_refused: Not in the demo: every game stays
library.manage_subtitle: What is kept on this console
library.uninstall_text:
Uninstall {}?

Its saves stay in the cloud.
library.like_lead: A row that keeps only the covers on screen: aurore::HRecyclerFrame.

blurbs.adventure: Cross valleys and summits at your own pace, a map in your pocket and a sunrise at every pass.
blurbs.racing: Neon roads, tight turns and a rival one second behind: hold the line until the finish.
blurbs.puzzle: Slide, turn and light the blocks: each board has one clever way out, and a few silly ones.
blurbs.platformer: Run, jump and gather every coin across floating ledges, one more try at a time.
blurbs.strategy: Build a keep, raise its banners and plan three moves ahead of your neighbours.
blurbs.rhythm: Tap to the beat on a stage of light: every song is a new pattern to master.
blurbs.space: Chart quiet planets and their rings, trade with outposts and find your way home.
blurbs.ocean: Sail under the moon, read the waves and dive where the old maps stop.

motion.easings_lead: The curves an animation follows, from tweeny: any value of a view can ride one.
motion.play_note: A dot runs along each curve: aurore::Animatable, one step of 1.4 s.
motion.states_lead: Move the focus on them: each change is a state style, animated by its transition. XML only.
motion.focus_lead: The highlight glides from one view to the next, and pulses where it rests.
motion.shake_note: At an edge, where there is nothing to go to, the highlight shakes instead.

text.languages_lead: Choose one: every screen is built again in it, the focus kept where it was.
text.sizes_lead: Every label grows at once, and the rows with it; Auto is larger on a TV.
text.scale_body: The text of a line, in a card
text.scale_meta: A caption, a code, a date
text.scripts_lead: Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, Chinese, Japanese and Korean in the same line, and emoji.
text.emoji_note: Twemoji's pictures, as Cadran's lists and Markdown draw them; a label draws colour emoji from the system's font, with FreeType.
text.long_lead: What a label does with a text longer than its room.
text.marquee_text: A title far too long for its tile scrolls by while the tile has the focus, then waits and starts again
text.shrink_text: A title too long for its tile, drawn smaller and smaller to stay on one line
text.paragraph: Labels wrap on their own, break lines where a language allows it, and grow as tall as their text needs. A screen taller than the window scrolls a line at a time with the D-pad, or freely with a finger or the mouse wheel.

themes.variant_lead: Every colour is a theme key: the screens change at the next frame, nothing is built again.
themes.palettes_lead: Cadran's own, the demo's theme files, then Aurore's presets: the seasons follow the calendar.
themes.file_lead: A text file: a few colours, and every key follows from them; pictures and decorations too.
themes.contrast: Each palette is checked: text at 4.5:1, shapes at 3:1.

input.controller_lead: Every button and both sticks, as the app reads them: a pad, or the keyboard standing in for it.
input.test_start: Press A here to test every button
input.test_stop: Testing: every button only shows here. Hold B to stop.
input.touch_lead: A tap leaves a ripple, a drag a trail: gesture recognizers on a view.
input.keyboard_lead: On a computer and in a browser, keys stand in for the controller.
input.hints_lead: Focus a card: the footer says what its buttons do there.

developers.frame_lead: Measured by aurore::Profiler while this tab shows, averaged over half a second.
developers.tools_lead: The inspector shows where a view sits, its colours, the focus and what a frame costs.
developers.inspector_note: Or F12 on a keyboard, L3 + R3 on a controller; again to browse the tree, again to close it.
developers.binding_lead: The figure, the colour and the word follow observables of a model; the button only changes the model.
developers.code_lead: Views in XML or in code, tested without a window.
developers.hot_reload: On a computer, AURORE_HOT_RELOAD=1 builds the screen again each time one of its XML files, or the theme, is saved.
